captures.description: THE ARCHIVE, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'UbuWeb is a free, ad-free digital library and online archive for avant-garde art, film, music, and poetry.' Overview & History (founded 1996 by Kenneth Goldsmith; mission; 'gift economy model, running with no budget'; status, 'Active'); Scope & Contents ('over 7,500 artists', 'more than 2,500 full-length avant-garde and experimental films and videos'; audio; poetry and /ubu Editions; papers). Four cards: Wikipedia, the Poetry Foundation, Arte Útil, Instagram; no card from ubu.com.

atoms.evidence: UbuWeb is a digital library of freely downloadable avant-garde art, film, music as well as visual, concrete and sound poetry.
is a free, ad-free digital library and online archive for avant-garde art, film, music, and poetry.
Audio & Music: Features mp3 archives, sound art, early internet audio, and curated collections like The 365 Days Project and Tellus Audio Cassette Magazine.
Mission: To provide open, web-based educational access to obscure, out-of-print, and marginalized avant-garde materials.
Operations: Built on a gift economy model, running with no budget, zero registration, and server/bandwidth support donated by universities.
